commercial_focus: Qualified Sydney owner conversations in established B2B and professional-service businesses

recent_first_party_evidence.latest_post: THE AD WORKED. THE HANDOFF DIDN'T.
recent_first_party_evidence.learning: Keep the idea-first physical consequence, but move away from another handoff story and explain the provider experience more directly.

planned_buyer_question: What happens during an on-site automation review?

concepts.concept: Follow the rope to the snag
concepts.hook: WE FIND WHERE THE WORK GETS STUCK.
concepts.visual: A hand follows an ochre rope to one tight snag on Sydney sandstone.

concepts.hook: ONE BLOCK CAN SLOW THE WHOLE FLOW.
concepts.visual: Water moves across a rock shelf except for one channel blocked by debris.
concepts.decision: rejected because the service mechanism is less explicit

concepts.concept: The queue stops at one gate
concepts.hook: THE DELAY IS AT ONE DECISION.
concepts.visual: A sequence of colour-coded folders stops at one locked outdoor gate.
concepts.decision: rejected as too constructed and close to office-document imagery

concepts.hook: ONE STEP CAN SLOW THE WHOLE CREW.
concepts.visual: A rowing crew in rhythm with one oar caught at the wrong angle.
concepts.decision: rejected because the issue may read as individual performance

concepts.hook: WE TRACE WHERE THE WORK GOES SIDEWAYS.
concepts.visual: A marked bush trail splits, with one worn path ending at a barrier.
concepts.decision: rejected because the workflow failure is less immediate

concepts.hook: ONE KNOT CHANGES THE WHOLE CATCH.
concepts.visual: Hands inspect one tangled section in an otherwise orderly fishing net.
concepts.decision: rejected because it risks a trades or fishing-led reading

concepts.hook: THE SYSTEM MOVED. YOUR WORK DIDN'T.
concepts.visual: An airport baggage belt turns around one stationary tagged case.
concepts.decision: rejected as stock-like and difficult to control without brand clutter

concepts.hook: THE HOLD-UP IS SMALL BUT EXPENSIVE.
concepts.visual: A climbing line stops at one misaligned carabiner on sandstone.
concepts.decision: rejected because it introduces unnecessary safety and danger cues

selected_concept.commercial_failure: The owner cannot tell where repeated work and handover friction are actually costing attention, delay or reliability.
selected_concept.service_mechanism: Follow one recent workflow from trigger to outcome, inspect every handoff and exception, then rank one practical automation opportunity.
selected_concept.human_boundary: The system can move information and surface decisions. People keep advice, approvals, unusual cases and relationship judgement.
